title: A highly-sensitive multisubstrate-compatible chemiluminescent immunoassay for human fetuin A
protocol: Reconstitute a BupH Phosphate Buffered Saline Pack in 500 mL of autoclaved DIW.
Dissolve well to prepare PBS at pH 7.2.
Store PBS at RT for up to one week or at 4°C for up to four weeks.
Reconstitute a BupH MES Buffered Saline Pack in 500 mL of autoclaved DIW.
Dissolve well to prepare MES at pH 4.7.
Store MES at RT for up to two weeks.
Reconstitute APTES solution in autoclaved DIW to make a 2% (v/v) solution immediately before use.
Incubate each desired well of a 96-well CMTP plate with 100 μL of 1% (w/v) KOH for 10 min at 37°C.
Wash the wells five times with 300 μL DIW per well using an automatic plate washer if available.
Reconstitute 25 g EDC in 0.1 M MES buffer, pH 4.7 to make a 8 mg/mL solution.
Aliquot and store EDC effectively at -20°C for up to six months.
Reconstitute 5 g SulfoNHS in 0.1 M MES, pH 4.7 to make a 22 mg/mL solution.
Aliquot and store SulfoNHS effectively at -20°C for up to six months.
Incubate KOH-treated CMTP with 100 μL of 2% v/v APTES for 1 hour at room temperature inside the fume cabinet.
Wash the APTES-modified wells extensively with DIW as described in step 1.
Mix 5 µL each of EDC and SulfoNHS to make 10 µL of pre-mixed EDC-SulfoNHS solution.
Incubate 990 μL of anti-HFA capture antibody with 10 μL of EDC-SulfoNHS solution for 15 minutes at 37 ºC.
Incubate the EDC-SulfoNHS activated antibody in APTES-functionalized wells for 1 hour at 37 ºC and wash five times with 300 µL of 0.1M PBS, pH 7.4.
Block the antibody-bound wells with 300 μL of 1% w/v BSA for 30 minutes at 37 ºC followed by extensive washing with PBS as mentioned in step 5.
Add 100 µL of varying HFA concentrations (0.3 pg/mL-20 ng/mL) to different BSA-blocked wells and incubate for 1 hour at 37 ºC, then wash extensively with PBS as stated in step 5.
Add 100 μL of biotinylated anti-HFA antibody in each of the HFA-captured wells and incubate for 1 hour at 37 ºC followed by extensive washing with PBS as mentioned in step 5.
Add 100 µL of streptavidin-HRP conjugate to the biotinylated anti-HFA antibody treated wells.
Incubate for 20 min at 37 ºC.
Wash extensively with PBS.
Add 100 µL of working solution, formed by mixing equal parts of SuperSignal ELISA Femto Luminol/Enhancer and SuperSignal ELISA Femto Stable Peroxide Solution, to each of the CMTP wells.
Incubate at RT for 5 min.
Record the chemiluminescent intensity at 425 nm in the Tecan Infinite M200 Pro microplate reader.
